Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.label: Church of the Bright Edge
Cultist.CultistCatalogDef.description: An occult society dedicated to the Hours of struggle and conquest. [You can use Cults with the Talk verb to recruit or promote followers, and to send them out on errands to gather resources. A Believer can be promoted to a Disciple; a few gifted Disciples can be exalted even higher, to Assassins.]
